title: QA Workbench Item
description: Schema for a bounded QA workbench item. QA items are advisory tracking artifacts — they do not imply defect acceptance, Owner approval, or seal authority. Each item captures a discrete QA finding, observation, or claim with evidence references and optional Owner decision state.

qa_item_id.description: Unique QA workbench item identifier (e.g. QA-FUNC-0001).

title.description: Short, descriptive title of the QA item.

source.description: Origin of this QA item within the QA Pilot pipeline or external input.

status.description: Current lifecycle state. All states are advisory-local — no status implies Owner approval, defect acceptance, verification, or seal authority.

from_status.description: Previous status, or __init__ for the item creation entry.

transition_reason.description: Required reason for the transition. Must not claim approval, verification, or seal authority.

actor.description: Optional identifier for who or what performed the transition (e.g. agent_name, session_id).

evidence_refs.description: Optional evidence references associated with this transition.

advisory_only.description: Must always be true. Lifecycle history entries are advisory-only.

lifecycle_history.description: Append-only lifecycle history. Each entry records a status transition with reason, actor, and optional evidence refs. History is advisory-only and does not confer approval, verification, or seal authority.

severity.description: Impact severity. Advisory-only classification — does not imply priority or action requirement.

category.description: Functional category of the QA finding.

description.description: Detailed description of the QA finding, observation, or claim.

items.description: Reference to a pipeline evidence artifact (evidence packet, epic regression suite, result packet, test case, or advisory review packet).

evidence_refs.description: List of evidence artifact references supporting this QA item.

items.description: Reference to a validation rule (e.g. PH-12, DR-4, AR-1).

validator_refs.description: List of validator rules associated with this QA item.

authority_note.const: Evidence attachment does not prove defect validity or imply Owner approval.

evidence_links.description: Structured evidence references attached to this QA item. Each link records the evidence artifact, its type, producing validator, and an authority disclaimer. Evidence links are advisory-only — they do not prove defect validity, imply Owner approval, or confer seal authority.

owner_decision_state.description: Current Owner decision state. 'accepted' does not confer seal authority — see advisory_only flag.

owner_decision_ref.description: Optional reference to an Owner decision receipt ID.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the QA item was created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last modification.

advisory_only.description: Must always be true. QA items are advisory-only and never confer seal or approval authority.

custody.description: Must always be qa-pilot-local. Items cannot claim cross-project custody.

librarian_impact.description: Must always be none. No QA item may claim Librarian mutation.
